timed_events.message: Pip: "The sun's moving fast, Steward! We'd better get started."
King Aldric (messenger): "How goes the preparation? The Queen is asking about the decorations."
Greta sends word: "If I don't have that menu soon, I'm serving PORRIDGE to the entire kingdom!"
MID-EVENT: Storm over the Bazaar. Merchants cover stalls — Bazaar locked for 2 minutes.
Storm passes. Bazaar reopens. Pip: "That was close! The merchants are back."
Lord Ashford sends an angry messenger: "If my stall isn't sorted by sundown, I'm boycotting the festival!"
Sir Cedric sends word: "The Proving Ground closes at dusk. If your Champion isn't ready, there'll be no rehearsal."
The sun begins to set. Golden light across all rooms. Pip: "Steward, we're running out of daylight!"
Torches are lit. Festival-goers start arriving early. Pip: "They're HERE! Are we ready?!"

triggered_events.message: The Soldier returns with the festival preparation schedule. Your first successful command!
The conduits hum with energy. Gate Pass and Scout Badge earned.
Ally recruited from the Bazaar! They're ready to help in the Kitchen.
Greta cheers — the feast menu is found! Roast pheasant, honeyed parsnips, elderflower wine!
Trade agreement signed! Ambassador Kael celebrates with a dance.
The King's Seal is written. Marshal rank earned. The Artificer can now book with authority.
All performers assigned! Mistress Thornbury takes a dramatic bow.
Last year's festival layout reconstructed from memory crystals.
Code of Honor configured. The Chronicler will be fair and factual.
Both nobles grudgingly satisfied. The stall designs are approved.
Champion assembled! Sir Cedric nods. Now run the rehearsal.
The Champion completes the rehearsal flawlessly. The festival is READY!
